name: Ladario
source: Agencia Nacional de Aguas e Saneamento Basico (ANA), HidroWeb web service
datum: cm above the Ladario staff gauge zero, listed at 82.15 m altitude (Embrapa Pantanal Doc. 14, 1995, citing BRASIL 1974)
license: No license on the HidroWeb service itself. The SNIRH metadata record for the national hydrometric network allows reproduction of the data provided the source is cited (https://metadados.snirh.gov.br/geonetwork/srv/api/records/f85dbf06-a869-414c-afc5-bb01869e9156). Credit: Agencia Nacional de Aguas e Saneamento Basico (ANA), HidroWeb.
notes: Datum check: 516 days where both the historic series and telemetry have a value (2025-01-01 to 2026-05-31); telemetry daily mean minus historic value: median +0.1 cm, mean +0.1 cm, 5th-95th percentile -1.6 to +1.5 cm. A median near zero means the two share the same gauge zero.

Historic series: ANA HidroSerieHistorica, tipoDados=1 (stage). Where a month exists at consistency level 2 (consistent, reviewed by ANA) we use it; otherwise level 1 (raw) and mark it provisional. Last level-2 date: 2023-12-31. Level-1 days used: 882.

Per-day status codes from ANA (CotaNNStatus): 25 days flagged 2 'estimated' are marked estimated; 0 days flagged 3 'doubtful' and 0 days flagged 4 'dry staff gauge' are kept as published with their consistency-level quality.

Daily value: ANA's daily-mean row where published (normally the mean of the 07:00 and 17:00 staff readings); otherwise the mean of the reading rows for that day. Days by source row: {'daily_mean_row': 46145}.

Historic record ends 2026-05-31. Days after that come from the ANA telemetry feed (DadosHidrometeorologicos, mostly 15-minute readings), averaged to a daily mean (139 days, marked provisional). Telemetry days with fewer than 12 readings: 0. Dropped as partial days (fewer than 75% of the readings the gauge usually sends per day, the median over the 61 days around it): 3, most recent 2026-07-15, 2026-07-16, 2026-10-20.
No fill values found in this series; ANA leaves missing days blank.
Share of days marked estimated by decade: {1950: 0.002, 1960: 0.0, 1970: 0.002, 2020: 0.005}.
ANA inventory altitude for the station: 82 m (station altitude, not the gauge zero).

measurement_history.fact: Embrapa: 95 years of uninterrupted daily records 1900-1994. The gauge is at the Brazilian Navy's 6th Naval District, and readings are released daily by the Navy's western nautical signaling service.
Gauge zero altitude is 82.15 m (Embrapa, citing BRASIL 1974).
ANA inventory: recorder 1996-04-01 to 1998-11-01, telemetry from 1996-04-01. Operator SGB-CPRM.
Not found: hour of the daily reading, gauge moves or zero changes, upstream dams affecting this site, any publisher statement on early accuracy.

public_notes: Embrapa reports 95 years of uninterrupted daily readings here from 1900 to 1994, released daily by Brazil's Navy. Values below zero are real low-water readings, not errors. Values after 2023 are not yet reviewed.
